f.title: Ensure suspected ADRs and therapeutic failures of own products are reported to the DNFD
f.statement: Laboratories, manufacturers, registration holders and distribution agencies are legally responsible for the safety of their medicines; the industry must therefore ensure that suspected adverse reactions and therapeutic failures of the medicines they manufacture or distribute are reported to the DNFD.

Por lo tanto la industria debe asegurar que las sospechas de reacciones adversas y fallas terapéuticas, de los medicamentos que fabriquen o distribuyen sean notificadas a la DNFD.

f.title: Have a PV system defining roles for ICSRs, PSURs, RMPs and PASS
f.statement: All registration holders must have a pharmacovigilance system detailing, among other things, roles and responsibilities for the safety and effectiveness of the medicines they market in Panama, ensuring timely measures when needed (management of suspected ADR and therapeutic-failure notifications, periodic safety reports, risk management plans, post-authorisation studies).

rows.quote: Asimismo, todos los titulares de registro de los medicamentos deben contar con un Sistema de Farmacovigilancia en el cual se deben detallar entre otros aspectos, los roles y responsabilidades relacionadas con la seguridad y efectividad de los medicamentos que comercializan en Panamá y asegurar así la adopción de medidas oportunas cuando sea necesario (Gestión de las notificaciones de sospechas de RAM y fallas terapéuticas, Informes Periódicos de Seguridad (IPS), Planes de Gestión de los Riesgos, estudios post autorización).

f.title: Serious ESAVI within 3 days of awareness
f.statement: Serious adverse events following vaccination must be reported within the times set by the regulation implementing Law 1 of 2001, which provides that serious suspected adverse reactions are reported within up to three days of becoming aware of them (non-serious: see the next row).

rows.quote: i. Revisar periódicamente las Notas de Seguridad de Medicamentos que publica el Centro Nacional de Farmacovigilancia de la Dirección Nacional de Farmacia y Drogas en la página web del Ministerio de Salud, con el fin de identificar información de seguridad que se deba actualizar en la monografía o ficha técnica y en el inserto o prospecto de sus medicamentos.
rows.review_note: Review: re-translated the quote independently; agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: i. Periodically review the Medicine Safety Notes published by the National Pharmacovigilance Centre of the National Directorate of Pharmacy and Drugs on the Ministry of Health website, in order to identify safety information that must be updated in the monograph or data sheet and in the insert or leaflet of its medicines.

f.title: Document the structure of the company PV unit
f.statement: The company must have a structure describing how the pharmacovigilance system of its PV section or unit functions.
f.clause: 4.3 Gestión de Calidad en la Industria Farmacéutica (IF)

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration (marketing authorisation holder)
rows.quote: Contar con una estructura que describa el funcionamiento del Sistema de Farmacovigilancia de la sección o unidad de farmacovigilancia de la empresa.
rows.location: 4.3 Gestión de Calidad en la Industria Farmacéutica (IF)
rows.review_note: Review: re-translated the quote independently; agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Have a structure that describes the functioning of the Pharmacovigilance System of the company's pharmacovigilance section or unit.

f.title: PV SOPs approved and signed by a technical director and the author; head of entity cannot be the RFV
f.statement: The registration holder must have standard operating procedures, approved and signed by a technical director and by the author, adequately describing the PV unit's functions and activities. The head of the entity may not be the RFV.

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration (marketing authorisation holder)
rows.quote: El TRS debe disponer de Procedimientos Operativos Estandarizados (POEs) aprobados y firmados por un director técnico de la organización y por el técnico que los elaboró, que describan de manera adecuada las funciones y actividades de FV que lleve a cabo la unidad. Se aclara que el responsable de la dirección de la entidad no podrá ser el RFV.
rows.review_note: Review: re-translated the quote independently; agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: The registration holder must have Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) approved and signed by a technical director of the organisation and by the technician who prepared them, adequately describing the PV functions and activities carried out by the unit. It is clarified that the person in charge of managing the entity may not be the RFV.

f.title: SOPs current, archived, available; staff trained with documented records
f.statement: The RFV and RPFV must know the PV SOPs to ensure their consistency, compliance and implementation. SOPs must be kept current with science and legislation and archived, be available to staff performing the tasks, and the RFV and everyone in the PV system must be trained on them, with that knowledge documented.

rows.actor: Registration holder; RFV and RPFV
rows.quote: El RFV y RPFV debe tener conocimiento de los POEs de la unidad o sección de FV para asegurar su consistencia y cumplimiento, como también de su implementación. Estos procedimientos tienen que estar actualizados de acuerdo con el estado científico actual y la legislación vigente y se deberá mantener un archivo de estos. Los procedimientos de farmacovigilancia tienen que estar a disposición del personal que realiza las tareas descritas en su puesto de trabajo. El RFV y todas las personas implicadas en el sistema de FV, deben estar formados en estos POEs
rows.review_note: Review: re-translated the quote independently; agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote. 'cuyo conocimiento debe quedar documentado' (documented training) continues after a page break; verified in the text.
rows.quote_en: The RFV and RPFV must have knowledge of the SOPs of the PV unit or section to ensure their consistency and compliance, as well as their implementation. These procedures must be updated in accordance with the current state of science and the legislation in force, and an archive of them must be kept. Pharmacovigilance procedures must be available to the staff who perform the tasks described in their job. The RFV and all persons involved in the PV system must be trained in these SOPs

f.title: Minimum set of PV SOPs
f.statement: Working procedures must cover at least: RFV activities and absence cover, and communication of RFV data to the CNFV; collection, coding (MedDRA, WHO dictionaries), recording, evaluation, follow-up, duplicate detection and reporting of ADR/TF/ESAVI; regulatory safety measures; PSUR content, preparation, approval and submission; continuous safety profile evaluation (signals, benefit-risk, communicating changes); RMPs; urgent safety restrictions and PV variations; coordination with other MAH functions; PV database management (validation, use, maintenance, security, back-up and recovery); post-authorisation studies; PV archive; urgent safety measures; and documentation of staff training and qualification.
f.processes: Quality system & CAPA; Case processing & follow-up; Safety system configuration; Aggregate reporting

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration (marketing authorisation holder)
rows.quote: b. Recopilación, codificación (utilización de diccionarios médicos estandarizados, por ejemplo, MedDRA, WHO, etc.) registro, evaluación, seguimiento, detección de duplicados y notificación de RAM/FT/ESAVI de sus medicamentos que se comercializa en el país. c. Adopción y seguimiento de medidas reguladoras adoptadas por motivos de seguridad. d. Contenido, preparación, aprobación y envío de IPS.
rows.review_note: Review: list summarised; the quote proves items b-d, the remaining items (a, e-m) were verified in the text (items a and the lead-in sit next to OCR noise). Double-check: below 90 because the quote proves only part of the list.
rows.quote_en: b. Collection, coding (use of standardised medical dictionaries, e.g. MedDRA, WHO, etc.), recording, evaluation, follow-up, duplicate detection and reporting of ADR/TF/ESAVI of its medicines marketed in the country. c. Adoption and follow-up of regulatory measures adopted for safety reasons. d. Content, preparation, approval and submission of PSURs.

f.title: PV database SOP: validation, use, maintenance, security, back-up and recovery
f.statement: Procedures must cover management and use of PV databases: validation, use, maintenance, security, back-ups and data recovery.
f.processes: Safety system configuration; Validation & change control; Data integrity & records

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration (marketing authorisation holder)
rows.quote: i. Gestión y uso de bases de datos de FV: validación, utilización, mantenimiento, seguridad, copias de seguridad y recuperación de datos.
rows.review_note: Review: re-translated the quote independently; agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: i. Management and use of PV databases: validation, use, maintenance, security, back-ups and data recovery.

f.title: Procedures for urgent safety measures and documented staff training
f.statement: Procedures must also cover adoption of urgent measures for safety reasons on marketed medicines, and documentation of training and qualification of all staff involved in any pharmacovigilance activity.

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration (marketing authorisation holder)
rows.quote: l. Contar con procedimientos para adoptar medidas urgentes por motivos de seguridad de los medicamentos que comercializan. m. Documentar las capacitaciones y calificación del personal que participa en cualquier actividad de farmacovigilancia.
rows.review_note: Review: re-translated the quote independently; agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: l. Have procedures for adopting urgent measures for safety reasons for the medicines they market. m. Document the training and qualification of personnel participating in any pharmacovigilance activity.

f.title: Submit PSURs per regulation; keep a PSUR schedule and submission log
f.statement: PSURs must be submitted as set out in the regulations in force. The registration holder together with the RFV must set a schedule for preparing and submitting PSURs, identify products by time on market and type (biological/biotechnological, narrow safety margin), and keep a register of PSURs/PBRERs sent to the CNFV with key data such as registration number, period covered, trade name and ATC.
f.clause: 4.4 Informe Periódicos de Seguridad (IPS) o PBRER

rows.actor: Registration holder with the RFV
rows.quote: La presentación de los IPS se debe realizar de acuerdo con lo establecido en la normativa vigente. El TRS junto con el RFV deben establecer un cronograma de elaboración y presentación de IPS, así como de tener identificados los productos de acuerdo con el tiempo de permanencia en el mercado y tipo (biológico y biotecnológico, margen de seguridad estrecho). De igual forma contar con un sistema de registro de los IPS/PBRER que se envían al CNFV con la información importante como: registro sanitario, período del IPS/PBRER que comprende, nombre comercial y ATC.
rows.location: 4.4 Informe Periódicos de Seguridad (IPS) o PBRER
rows.review_note: Review: re-translated the quote independently; agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: The submission of PSURs must be made in accordance with the regulations in force. The registration holder together with the RFV must establish a schedule for preparing and submitting PSURs, and have the products identified according to the time on the market and type (biological and biotechnological, narrow safety margin). Likewise, have a register of the PSURs/PBRERs sent to the CNFV with important information such as: sanitary registration, period covered by the PSUR/PBRER, trade name and ATC.

f.title: When an RMP must be submitted to the CNFV
f.statement: Submitting the Risk Management Plan to the CNFV is mandatory: when applying for registration of a biotechnological or biological medicine; when, in the CNFV's judgement, health risks warrant it; and when relevant changes occur to the initial authorisation conditions.
f.applicability: Biological and biotechnological medicines at registration; others when the CNFV requires or authorisation conditions change

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration (marketing authorisation holder)
rows.quote: El Plan de Gestión de Riesgo será obligación presentarlo al CNFV en los siguientes casos: a. Cuando se solicite el registro sanitario de un medicamento biotecnológico o biológico. b. Para los casos en los que a juicio del CNFV se identifiquen riesgos sanitarios que ameriten su presentación. c. En casos que se presenten cambios relevantes con la condición inicial de autorización del medicamento.
rows.review_note: Review: re-translated the quote independently; agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Submission of the Risk Management Plan to the CNFV shall be an obligation in the following cases: a. When the sanitary registration of a biotechnological or biological medicine is requested. b. In cases where, in the judgement of the CNFV, health risks are identified that warrant its submission. c. In cases where relevant changes arise with respect to the initial authorisation condition of the medicine.

f.title: RMP minimum content
f.statement: The RMP must contain at least: identification or description of the safety profile; a pharmacovigilance plan defining activities to prevent or reduce risks, including evaluation of their effectiveness and registration documentation; and documentation of post-authorisation obligations imposed as conditions of the marketing authorisation.

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration (marketing authorisation holder)
rows.quote: El Plan de Gestión de Riesgo de los medicamentos contendrá como mínimo los siguientes apartados: a. Identificación o descripción del perfil de seguridad del medicamento incluido en el documento. b. Plan de Farmacovigilancia, en la que se definan las actividades para prevenir o reducir los riesgos asociados con el medicamento, incluyendo la evaluación de la efectividad de dichas intervenciones y la documentación de registro. c. Documentación de las obligaciones posteriores a la autorización que fueron impuestas como condición para el otorgamiento de la autorización de comercialización.
rows.review_note: Review: re-translated the quote independently; agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: The Risk Management Plan of medicines shall contain at least the following sections: a. Identification or description of the safety profile of the medicine included in the document. b. Pharmacovigilance Plan, defining the activities to prevent or reduce the risks associated with the medicine, including evaluation of the effectiveness of those interventions and the registration documentation. c. Documentation of post-authorisation obligations imposed as a condition for granting the marketing authorisation.

f.title: Submit an RMP summary per medicine
f.statement: The registration holder must submit to the CNFV an RMP summary with key elements, focusing on risk minimisation activities and safety specifications, and relevant information on identified and potential risks and missing information; minimisation activities may be published. Where an RMP covers several medicines, an individual summary per medicine is submitted.

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration (marketing authorisation holder)
rows.quote: El titular de registro sanitario presentará al CNFV un resumen del Plan de Gestión de Riesgo que contendrá elementos claves, prestando especial atención a las actividades de minimización de riesgos y especificaciones de seguridad del medicamento, información relevante sobre riesgos identificados, potenciales e información no conocida. La actividades para la minimización de riesgo presentadas por el titular de registro sanitario serán publicadas en el tiempo que se amerite. Cuando un Plan de Gestión de Riesgo se refiera a más de un medicamento, se presentará al CNFV un resumen individual por medicamento.
rows.review_note: Review: re-translated the quote independently; agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: The sanitary registration holder shall submit to the CNFV a summary of the Risk Management Plan containing key elements, paying special attention to risk minimisation activities and the safety specifications of the medicine, relevant information on identified and potential risks and missing information. The risk minimisation activities submitted by the registration holder shall be published as appropriate. When a Risk Management Plan refers to more than one medicine, an individual summary per medicine shall be submitted to the CNFV.

f.title: Submit RMP updates for review and approval, then an updated summary
f.statement: When the registration holder updates the RMP it must submit it to the CNFV for review and approval (partial or full update); once approved, it submits an updated RMP summary.

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration (marketing authorisation holder)
rows.quote: Cuando el titular de registro sanitario actualice el Plan de Gestión de Riesgo, debe presentarlo al CNFV para su revisión y aprobación. Esta actualización podrá limitarse a una parte o a la totalidad del plan. Una vez aprobado, el titular de registro sanitario presentará un resumen actualizado del plan de gestión de riesgos.
rows.review_note: Review: re-translated the quote independently; agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: When the sanitary registration holder updates the Risk Management Plan, it must submit it to the CNFV for review and approval. This update may be limited to part or all of the plan. Once approved, the sanitary registration holder shall submit an updated summary of the risk management plan.

f.title: Report ADRs and therapeutic failures via the DNFD electronic form
f.statement: The pharmaceutical industry must report suspected adverse reactions and therapeutic failures through the electronic form made official by the DNFD.
f.clause: 5.1 Gestión de Calidad de FV para las Notificaciones de Sospechas de RAM y Fallas Terapéuticas

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical industry (manufacturers, registration holders and distributors)
rows.quote: La industria farmacéutica debe realizar la notificación de sospechas de reacciones adversas y fallas terapéuticas a través del formulario electrónico oficializado por
rows.location: 5.1 Gestión de Calidad de FV para las Notificaciones de Sospechas de RAM y Fallas Terapéuticas
rows.review_note: Review: re-translated the quote independently; agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: The pharmaceutical industry must report suspected adverse reactions and therapeutic failures through the electronic form made official by [the DNFD]

f.title: Minimum content of ADR notification forms
f.statement: Notification forms must contain at least: patient data (name or initials, gender, age); reaction description (location, seriousness, intensity, onset and end dates of signs and symptoms, evolution and outcome); suspect medicine (name, active ingredient(s), indication, dose, route, dosage form, manufacturer, lot number and expiry date, exact start and stop dates, action taken, rechallenge data); and notifier or PV contact details (name, signature and professional registration, phone, e-mail and health facility).
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; ICSR quality control

rows.actor: Notifiers, including the pharmaceutical industry
rows.quote: a. Datos del Paciente: nombre o iniciales del paciente, género, edad. b. Descripción de la reacción adversa: localización anatómica y gravedad, intensidad incluyendo la fecha, fechas de inicio y término de los signos y síntomas, su evolución y desenlace. c. Medicamento sospechoso: nombre del medicamento, ingrediente(s) activo(s), indicación, dosis, vía de administración, forma farmacéutica, nombre del fabricante, número de lote y fecha de vencimiento y fecha exacta de la administración y suspensión del medicamento, acción tomada con el fármaco y datos de re exposición si se ha producido. d. Datos del notificador o contacto de Farmacovigilancia: nombre, firma y registro de idoneidad, teléfono de contacto,
rows.review_note: Review: re-translated the quote independently; agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote. Quote stops before the e-mail item (checker rule); the statement lists it from the source. Lead-in says 'debe contener' (must contain).
rows.quote_en: a. Patient data: patient's name or initials, gender, age. b. Description of the adverse reaction: anatomical location and seriousness, intensity including the date, start and end dates of the signs and symptoms, their evolution and outcome. c. Suspect medicine: name of the medicine, active ingredient(s), indication, dose, route of administration, dosage form, manufacturer name, lot number and expiry date and exact date of administration and discontinuation of the medicine, action taken with the drug and rechallenge data if it occurred. d. Data of the notifier or Pharmacovigilance contact: name, signature and professional registration, contact telephone,

f.title: Industry and distributors must have SOPs for every PV activity
f.statement: The pharmaceutical industry and distribution agencies must have SOPs for each PV activity they perform, prepared and reviewed by their PV leads, implemented and known by the staff involved.

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical industry and distribution agencies
rows.quote: Los CRFV, CIFV, UFVH o Comités, la Industria Farmacéutica y las Agencias Distribuidoras deben contar con PNT para cada actividad de FV que realicen, los cuales deben ser elaborados y revisados por los encargados de FV de cada institución que deberán ser tanto implementados como de conocimiento, por parte del personal involucrado.
rows.review_note: Review: re-translated the quote independently; agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: The CRFV, CIFV, UFVH or Committees, the Pharmaceutical Industry and the Distribution Agencies must have SOPs for each PV activity they carry out, which must be prepared and reviewed by those in charge of PV in each institution, and which must be both implemented and known by the personnel involved.

f.title: SOP identification data
f.statement: Every SOP in the national PV system must show at least: procedure name and code; date of final drafting; name and signature of the quality assurance lead (if applicable); and related procedures.

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical industry and distribution agencies
rows.quote: En todos los procedimientos normalizados de trabajo del SNFV deben identificarse al menos los siguientes datos: >--Nombre del procedimiento y codificación asignada >--Fecha de su redacción definitiva >--Nombre y firma del responsable de garantía de calidad (si aplica) >--Nombre de los procedimientos operativos de trabajo relacionados
rows.review_note: Review: re-translated the quote independently; agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: All standard operating procedures of the SNFV must identify at least the following data: - Name of the procedure and assigned code - Date of its final drafting - Name and signature of the quality assurance lead (if applicable) - Name of the related operating procedures

f.title: Run an internal PV audit programme
f.statement: Registration holders must establish internal audit programmes to verify periodically compliance of the areas and elements of their PV quality management system, in order to: determine conformity; check implementation and documentation; verify execution and effectiveness; provide improvement opportunities; meet DNFD PV requirements; verify staff meet their obligations; and identify, follow up and resolve non-conformities.
f.clause: 5.5 Revisión de los procesos de Farmacovigilancia (Auditorías de Farmacovigilancia)
f.processes: Quality system & CAPA; Audit & inspection readiness

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration (marketing authorisation holder)
rows.quote: Los Titulares de registro sanitario de medicamentos, deben establecer programas de auditorías internas de tal forma que permita la verificación periódica del cumplimiento de las áreas y elementos del Sistema de Gestión de Calidad del Sistema de Farmacovigilancia que implementa, con los objetivos siguientes:
rows.location: 5.5 Revisión de los procesos de Farmacovigilancia (Auditorías de Farmacovigilancia)
rows.review_note: Review: re-translated the quote independently; agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote. Objectives a-h verified in the text and summarised in the statement.
rows.quote_en: Medicine sanitary registration holders must establish internal audit programmes so as to allow periodic verification of compliance of the areas and elements of the Quality Management System of the Pharmacovigilance System they implement, with the following objectives:

f.title: Independent auditors; record audits, findings and corrective actions
f.statement: Internal audits must be performed independently by people not directly involved in the audited processes, appointed by the organisation. All internal audits must be recorded with observations and any proposed corrective measures, and the actions taken as a result of the self-inspection must also be recorded.
f.processes: Quality system & CAPA; Audit & inspection readiness

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration (marketing authorisation holder)
rows.quote: Las auditorías internas deben realizarse de forma independiente por personas no involucradas directamente en los procesos que se auditan y deben ser nombrados a tal efecto por la organización a la que pertenece. Todas las auditorías internas deben quedar registradas y deben incluir las observaciones realizadas y en su caso las propuestas de medidas correctivas. También deben de quedar registradas las actividades emprendidas como consecuencia de la autoinspección.
rows.review_note: Review: re-translated the quote independently; agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Internal audits must be carried out independently by persons not directly involved in the processes being audited and must be appointed for that purpose by the organisation to which they belong. All internal audits must be recorded and must include the observations made and, where applicable, the proposed corrective measures. The activities undertaken as a consequence of the self-inspection must also be recorded.

dates.title: Panama DNFD Resolution 007/2024 (BPFV manual, November 2023): takes effect
dates.scope: All components of the National Pharmacovigilance System, including the pharmaceutical industry; repeals Resolution 553 of 3 June 2019
dates.quote: CUARTO: La presente Resolución comenzará a regir a partir de su promulgación.
dates.quote_en: FOURTH: This Resolution shall enter into force upon its promulgation.
